s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive painful swelling and infiltration of the face, hands, and other areas with a rapid decline in functional status
salient_findings: Painful swelling of the face, particularly affecting the eyelids, periorbital tissues, and hands
Striking infiltration of the eyelids and periorbital skin with multiple firm tumorous swellings
Diffusely rippled appearance of the skin on the forehead, neck, shoulders, and anterior chest
Swollen hands and fingers with scattered focal purpuric infarcts
key_facts: Increasing drowsiness and weakness over 7 days
Dermal oedema and scattered histiocytes on biopsy
Widespread fibrinoid exudates within deeper tissues
Granulomatous inflammation with intense neutrophilic abscesses in subcutaneous fat
Mucin stains (PAS, Alcian blue) initially negative
Hale's colloidal iron staining showed deep dermal mucin

shortlist.label: Scleromyxedema
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation of progressive painful swelling and infiltration of the face, hands, and other areas, along with mucin stains and granulomatous inflammation on biopsy

shortlist.label: Erythema nodosum
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of painful swelling and granulomatous inflammation, although the lack of eosinophilia and specific biopsy findings make it less likely

shortlist.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms, granulomatous inflammation, and presence of neutrophilic abscesses, although the clinical presentation is not typical

shortlist.label: Panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of subcutaneous fat with granulomatous inflammation and neutrophilic abscesses, consistent with the clinical presentation

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and systemic symptoms, although the clinical presentation and biopsy findings are not typical for this condition

raw.rationale: The presence of dermal oedema, scattered histiocytes, widespread fibrinoid exudates, granulomatous inflammation, and deep dermal mucin on biopsy are consistent with Scleromyxedema, a rare skin condition characterized by mucin deposition and fibrosis.

rejected.label: Erythema nodosum
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic erythematous nodules on the lower extremities

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: Normal chest radiograph and lack of respiratory symptoms

rejected.label: Panniculitis
rejected.why: While panniculitis is present, the combination of mucin deposition and other skin findings point more towards Scleromyxedema

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic non-caseating granulomas and systemic symptoms
